title: Sordland/Turn02/InT_HighwayContract
description: This conversation is available if the President has chosen to build the H-3 Highway. The intracies of this project is that it strengthens Lileas Graf's political connection Eric Niel the mayor of Arvory. Also the S.S.C. company. It avoids Laren and other villages away from the coast thus not fixing the infrastructure situation entirely. The advantages are heightened trade with Agnolia and more business investment in the region. This will lift people out of poverty. Symon Holl is neutral in his advocation. There is a choice between giving the contract and then the project responsibility to Symon or Lileas Graf.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The company will be notified today..."
entries.dialogueText: “The company will be notified today and construction work will begin immediately after.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Some in the Lotherberg Group will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Some in the Lotherberg Group will be pleased. The contract will be awarded to Underhall Construction.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a lengthy drive on cliffside..."
entries.dialogueText: After a lengthy drive on cliffside roads, we arrived in Lenkurg. There, crowds of cheering citizens greeted us and the local government officials escorted us to the city hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were here for a significant meet..."
entries.dialogueText: We were here for a significant meeting about the H-3 project. Several construction companies sent their representatives to the city hall.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We'll not let the people or oursel..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll not let the people or ourselves down. I won't let that happen to any of us.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus Manger couldn't make the meetin..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus Manger couldn't make the meeting due to his visit to Rizia, but I had Symon Holl and Lileas Graf by my side.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Besides starting our economic reco..."
entries.dialogueText: “Besides starting our economic recovery, this project will cut the time it takes to get here by road in half, Mr. President.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“More importantly, it will lead to..."
entries.dialogueText: “More importantly, it will lead to improvement in Agnland. I have lived with these people and seen them suffer.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I had to work with Underhall Const..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had to work with Underhall Construction before in Holsord. They accepted several contracts for the renovation of our central station and left much to be desired. The H-3 project shouldn't be left to them.”

entries.dialogueText: “I am glad to hear that. We should be able to slow down the recession if we finish this project successfully.”

entries.dialogueText: “According to my estimations this project will give about 50.000 citizens from Agnland employment.”

entries.dialogueText: “I look forward to a positive financial outcome. According to my sources, we'll lift many people in these areas out of poverty.”

entries.dialogueText: The meeting ended and we spent the remainder of the day attending events in Lenkurg.

entries.dialogueText: “If we are going to try a different company, this is the most unique.”

entries.dialogueText: “It would fit our election promises of switching to a free-market economy. Awarding contracts to privately owned corporations would be a step in the right direction.”
